# webtables/var

> Variable read: a word loaded from the variable's address in linear memory.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/var.pkg)

Every variable lives in memory, because WebAssembly locals have no
address and `&x` must work; see [storage](storage.md). The `addr`
section gives the address as a word, for `&x`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.load {addr})
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
(i64.extend_i32_u {addr})
```
